meta.name: few-shot-patterns
meta.description: Crafting examples that steer AI behavior effectively.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计示例来引导AI输出符合预期
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过示例让AI更准确地完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Design examples to steer AI output as expected
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to guide AI behavior with well-crafted examples

howto.what: 你给Claude一些输入-输出的例子，它会学会这些例子的模式，然后按相同模式处理你的新输入。示例越好，输出越好。
howto.when: 当你只靠指令说不清楚，需要展示格式、风格或处理特殊情况的例子时，就可以用这个方法。

say.text: 给你几个例子，请按此格式回答。
say.note: 提供示例后，Claude会模仿格式。

say.text: 请模仿这些示例的风格写一段产品描述。
这是正确和错误处理的示例，请根据情况处理输入。
say.note: 示例包含边缘情况，Claude学会区分。

howto.what_en: You provide input-output examples; Claude learns the pattern and applies it to new inputs. Example quality directly determines output quality.
howto.when_en: Use when instructions alone are insufficient to convey format, style, or edge-case handling. The method is triggered by providing examples.

say_en.text: Here are a few examples. Please respond in the same format.
say_en.note: Claude mimics the format after seeing examples.

say_en.text: Follow the style of these examples to write a product description.
say_en.note: Examples demonstrate style; Claude applies it.

say_en.text: These are examples of correct and incorrect handling. Handle inputs accordingly.
say_en.note: Examples include edge cases; Claude learns to distinguish.
